multi_entity_note: Coral Gold Resources Ltd. (Company) and Intermark Capital Corp. (Consultant), plus the Principal David Wolfin.
processing_note: In addition, the Company will pay to the Consultant all reasonable expenses of the Consultant as agreed to from time to time which are incurred by the Consultant in delivery of the Services, based on monthly invoices submitted to the Company, including copies of all paid receipts; plus harmonized sales taxes or goods and services taxes, as the case may be, in addition to the Consulting Fees, which taxes will be remitted by the Consultant to the Canada Revenue Agency.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is dated for reference the 1st day of February, 2020; the later February 1, 2020 mention defines the Effective Date as distinct from the execution date, and the other dates are fee or term dates.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The preamble defines the Effective Date as the 1st day of February, 2020 and Section 21.1(n) restates it as February 1, 2020; the fee commencement and 2025 dates and the bare term 'Effective Date' play other roles.

contract.notice_period.rationale: The agreement has a fixed five-year term with no renewal, so there is no notice period to prevent renewal; the 3-month notices are for early termination.
